notes.title: Slender Myth Beta Testing
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone, and we hope you're enjoying your day. We recently finished the primary map, bringing us closer to finishing our game "Slender Myth" with each passing day. You can participate in a beta test that will be conducted to ensure that it is well made and to check for problems and glitches. You only need to message us via mail (velja.vracarevic@steelrainstudios.com) to let us know you're interested in doing this. Beta testers will be given a free copy of the game as a thank you and will also have their names listed in the game. We appreciate your time.



-Sincerely,
Steel Rain Studios Team

notes.title: State Of The Game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you are having an amazing year so far.
We sincerely apologize for the wait and for not notifying everyone, we are currently adding more content to the game since after further play testing the game was deemed, by majority of testers (31/43 beta testers), too short and repetitive near the end. We hope you understand. As for the release date we will notify everyone when we are 100% sure that the game is ready and near flawless. We will be releasing a gameplay trailer later this month so everyone can take a proper look at the game. As for the release date it is TBA.

We thank you yet again for your patience.

- Sincerely,
Steel Rain Studios Team

notes.title: Delaying the game due to several glitches
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone, we hope you are having an amazing day, we will unfortunately have to delay the game release to mid January due to the game having several glitches which would impact its experience. Special thanks for being patient and sticking with us!

- Sincerely,
Steel Rain Studios Team

notes.title: Some clarification about the game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you are having an amazing day, we just wanted to clarify something to the audience. While the page collecting, in our opinion, has been engraved into slender too much for it to be removed it is not the main goal of the game, its more of a typical side quest. The main goal is what had been previously stated in about game section, piecing together the story behind this place. That about covers everything we wanted to say, we hope you have a nice week.

- Sincerely, Steel Rain Studios Team
